IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, September 17, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA**
The data center run continues to print. Sixty-two calls across Miller Electrical, Inglett & Stubbs, and Whitehead Electric—all QTS Fayetteville work, all **$42/hr**, all running 4-10s with weekend 8s. Miller's got the deepest call at 79 Inside JW; Whitehead's cable tray hang is moving. Every call on the board pays the same rate. This is volume work, not specialty money, but it's rock-solid and the schedule is locked.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI**
Port Washington Data Center is the entire story here. Cupertino Electric and Gurtz Electric are each running 30 Inside JW on a repost, currently paying **JW wage plus $10/hr base**. That premium is the hook—take it seriously. MJ Electric's got 15 outside underground duct bank work running 50–58 hours. Wil-Surge has 16 more. Forty-four calls total, just over 200 hands on books. This is short-cycle work with real money stacked on top.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN**
Google Data Center Mooresville is the anchor: Ermco running 15 JW on a **$54.75** call, 5-10s and Saturdays with all OT at double time. Industrial Electric's pushing Eli Lilly (6-10s Monday–Saturday, new construction) and rotating 13-on-1-off at LTCS. Thirty-seven calls, 119 hands. The Google job is the premium ticket here.

**LU-354 Salt Lake City, UT**
Cache Valley Electric owns the board: 25 at P&G Corrine (**$46.22/hr**, 6-10s), 10 at Facebook Eagle Mountain (**$46.22**, 5-day with OT and Saturdays). Winward's got 14 at QTS Eagle Mountain (**$46.22**, 5-day). Forty-four calls across three contractors on three major tenants. Every Inside JW call pays the same scale. Steady, clean, and repeatable.

**LU-134 Chicago, IL**
Freeman Electric is mobilizing this weekend: 61 JW at McCormick Place South (Foreman: Dia Rowls), 35 at West (Amanda Fitzgerald), 16 at East (Nick Kusles)—all three going live **Saturday 09/19**. This is a 112-hand push into three buildings. Chicago Power's got 4 more on temperature control in the Loop. The board is small (14 calls, 131 hands) but the immediate start is rare and hard to pass.

**LU-575 Portsmouth, OH**
Amazon North Campus, Jeffersonville: TSG is running 97 JW on a 4-10 starting **Monday, September 21**. Hanley's got 2 more on 5-8s. This is the biggest board-per-hand ratio on today's snapshot—nearly a hundred-to-one. Get there early.

Data centers and big-box retail are absorbing the float. Infrastructure work is still moving, but the capital's chasing compute.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, September 17, 2026**

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** is running hot. SERVICE ELECTRIC's Social Circle energized work is **$56.80/hr** with **$150/day per diem** (Quanta barehand cert required), and they've got transmission energized work at **$56.80 + $10 scale**. FAITH ELECTRIC's College Park/Columbus gig is **$49.80/hr** — that's **$3 over JW scale** — on 4-10s with hotels provided. Board sits at 39 calls, 130 hands deep. This is Georgia Power territory moving fast.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** has 44 calls chasing 69 hands. MJ Electric's Winamac transmission job (345kv 954/Bundle install) is **$67.18/hr** with **$105/day per diem** — CDL A required. ARC American's Wanatah rebuild work is **$64.66/hr** with no per diem, but it's 12.5k rebuilds and solid. Kent Power has distribution work in Valparaiso at **$56.66 + $125/day**. Book 1's getting cleared here.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** has 46 calls and 140 hands waiting. NEW RIVER ELECTRIC is stacking 40 JL's on Columbus distro work with **$125/day per diem** and a **$125 bonus on 10hr days**; they've also got 9 JL's in Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional weekend hours. CDL A and 6-10s are standard. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS wants 6 JL's in Johnstown for cable splicing at **$100/day per diem**.

**LU-66 Houston, TX** sits at 19 calls, 74 hands. NHPL's got three separate calls: 19 JL's on overhead distro with **$150/day per diem** and all OT double time; 9 JL's on transmission to Floresville at **$175/day**; plus transmission techs at **$100/day for travelers only**. Class A CDL across the board. All OT double time is the play here.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 26 calls, 59 hands. Parsons Electric's running 19 Inside JW's at the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood — **$44.80/hr** plus **$100/day incentive M-F, $150 Sat/Sun**, and an additional **$100/day for ND license holders**. That's serious stacking potential if you're licensed. 60/60/50 OT structure, PLA job.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** shows 19 calls, 74 hands, nearly all Micron Idaho fabrication on PLA work. Most calls are **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) and **$20/hr travel pay**. One Quality Electric in-house call breaks at **$65.33/hr** on 4-10s, non-PLA. Different animal entirely.

The data center and transmission infrastructure buildout is pulling bodies hard — Boise, Grand Forks, Amarillo are the new gravity wells, and Texas distro is moving steady. Georgia's energized work premium sits fat.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, September 17, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running the heaviest board with 18 calls and 61 hands needed. BCS Mechanical has the volume play — 15 JW pipefitters and 13 JW plumbers on the Sego Project in West Valley, both posting 4-10s starting Aug 3 with OT kicker. DSI's got a tighter specialty gig: 6 JW pipefitters on the QTS data center in Eagle Mountain running 5-8s with a brutal 5-10s + 1-8 schedule and **$10.00/hr** rate. That's a head-scratcher unless it's hazmat or entry-level contract work — worth calling dispatch to clarify before you roll.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** has 23 calls chasing 47 hands into the Intel Ronler Acres fab complex in Hillsboro. Apollo Mechanical wants 8 CAD/BIM detailers; Charter's hunting 5 fitters and 4 high-purity specialists plus 3 orbital welders. Specialty tool-install work, no pay posted — call the hall for rates and whether this is journeyman or semi-skilled labor.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** is lean but clean: 14 calls, 46 hands. Kiewit's running a project gig at **$65.00/hr** with **$65 per diem** and night shift 15% differential — serious money for CWI work. US Eng. Metalworks is also staffing a shop with stainless fitters and TIG welders. Murphy's Coors 4-can filler needs 2 fitters and 2 TIG welders on schedule 5/10 stainless.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 5 calls but real density: Cenovus maintenance work through Graham and Nooter (both showing **$125/day per diem** incentive) hunting pipefitters on 6-10s and 7-10s. Gem's fab shop wants 5 combo welders.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is a skeleton board — 1 call, 12 hands — but it's Four Seasons towers in Henderson starting 7/30; OSHA 10/30 card mandatory.

The big boards (Salt Lake and Portland) are pulling hands toward industrial process and fab work; Denver's specialty welding and high-purity piping is staying tight.
